# Skopli

> Open-source SDK that reads AI coding-agent usage from the session logs each harness keeps on disk, rolls it up, and prices it against model catalogs. 40 harnesses, 9 languages, one Rust core. MIT.

Reading and rollups run offline against local files. Pricing is a separate step that matches model names to a catalog and leaves unknown models as `priced: false` instead of guessing.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/): guides and reference. Every page has a Markdown twin (swap the trailing `/` for `.md`).
- [llms.txt](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/llms.txt): index of the documentation pages.
- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/llms-full.txt): the whole documentation in one file.
- [Getting started](https://docs.skopli.com/skopli/guide/getting-started/): install for each language and the first priced rollup.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/skopli/skopli): source, issues, releases.
